Phasmophobia - Yes, I would recommend this game to others. 
  It's a scary ghost hunting game and I don't think there are to many of them around. This games proves that searching out spooks with the various equipment can be both fun and scary. There are jump scares and ghost can appear anywhere at any time, so be prepared. Oh and a ghost can hunt you. They can turn off lights, throw things, slam doors, blow out candles and haunt in various ways. The first time a door slamed shut right behind me - I almost jumped out of my skin. If you like being scared and don't mind the jump scares and things like that, you'll probably like this game.
